resources.name: Open-source DFT code (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO, ABINIT)

access.notes: Any DFT code supporting PW91 GGA with PAW pseudopotentials is acceptable.

resources.name: PAW pseudopotential library for PW91 (e.g., PSlibrary)

access.notes: Must provide PW91 PAW pseudopotentials for Ge and Ti.

resources.name: Crystal structure prototypes for Ge-Ti compounds and pure elements

access.notes: Structures: diamond Ge, hcp Ti, Mn5Si3-type Ge3Ti5, Ge4Sm5-type Ge4Ti5, Si5V6-type Ge5Ti6, TiSi2-type Ge2Ti. Available from ICSD or Materials Project.
